units.source_text: 此时天色似将下雨，木幡山一带道路险恶可怕。

en.t: At this time the sky looked as though it would rain, and the roads around Mount Kohata were dangerous and frightening.

units.source_text: 但匂亲王的使者想必是特选的勇士，

en.t: But Prince Niou's messenger must have been a specially chosen brave man,

units.source_text: 他毫不畏惧，经过阴森可怕的小竹丛时，

en.t: for he showed no fear at all, and even when he passed through the gloomy, terrifying thickets of small bamboo,

units.source_text: 也不停辔驻足，快马加鞭，

en.t: he did not rein in or pause, but urged his horse on at full speed,
and in a short while arrived at the prince's residence.
Prince Niou summoned the messenger before him,

units.source_text: 但见他浑身被夜露濡湿，便重重犒赏他。

en.t: and seeing that his whole body was soaked with night dew, rewarded him generously.

units.source_text: 拆开信来一看，觉得此信笔迹与往日来信不同，

en.t: When he opened the letter and looked at it, he felt that the handwriting was different from the letters he had received before,

units.source_text: 较为老练纯熟，字体非常优美。

en.t: more practiced and assured, with characters of exceptional beauty.

units.source_text: 不知何者是大女公子手笔，何者是二女公子手笔，

en.t: Unable to tell which was written by the elder princess and which by the younger princess,

units.source_text: 反复细看，不忍释手，竟忘记了睡觉。

en.t: he examined it closely again and again, could not bear to put it down, and even forgot to sleep.

units.source_text: 侍女们便窃窃私议：“说道要等回信，所以不去睡觉。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting whispered among themselves, "He said he had to wait for the reply, so he would not go to bed.

units.source_text: 现在回信到了，看了这许久还不肯放，不知那边是怎样称心如意的美人。”

en.t: Now the reply has arrived, yet he has been looking at it all this time and still will not let it go; one wonders what kind of beauty over there so perfectly pleases him."

units.source_text: 她们都很懊恼，大约是想睡觉了。

en.t: They were all quite annoyed, probably because they wanted to sleep.
